workload: dense 16-state converged Jacobian, 16 active parameters, 200000 varying cotangents per sample

validation.oracle: componentwise central finite difference of L(p)=u^T*x*(p), with every x*(p) obtained by a complete nonlinear root solve

memory_method: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) inside each separately launched candidate

selection.reason: both pass the independent complete-root objective oracle; reuse is 2.9820x faster, while refactorization uses 184320 fewer bytes of maximum observed candidate-process RSS, so an application workload must resolve the tradeoff
